caption: The drawing depicts a round, red, knitted or crocheted bag with a textured surface, featuring a repeating pattern of interlocking diamond shapes and stitches. The bag has a small, wide opening at the top, reinforced by a band decorated with zigzag and geometric motifs in a lighter, whitish color. Attached to the mouth of the bag is a short, wavy handle that matches the decorative band in its red and white color scheme. The body of the bag is predominantly red, overlaid with a lattice of crisscrossing threads, and it is accented with silver-gray or white triangular sections that appear to separate the bag into lobes. At the bottom tip of the bag, there is a white, leaf-like decorative element with a red pom-pom. The drawing is executed with careful attention to texture and detail, showing variations in thread thickness and stitch. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist's name, Erwin Schwabe, is written in small script in the lower right corner.
title: Crocheted Handbag
